# brainTrade Work Log

## 2026-08-21 15:45 UTC — [Pillar 3] ZEC regains economics as the point frontier broadens

**Task:** Refresh the public funding-arbitrage universe, uninterrupted episodes, Pareto frontier, and 29 bps carry-qualified depth queue under the frozen economics, capacity, hedgeability, and continuity rules.
**Finding:** Candidates expanded from 48 to 55 and raw actionable names from 26 to 32, with 100% actionable retention. BOME, CHIP, DOGE, MORPHO, UNI, and XPL entered as new actionable names and were correctly first-print blocked. The point executable intersection widened from FET/ONDO/GRAM/SUI/JUP/TRUMP to ONDO/ETHFI/MORPHO/ADA/GRAM/FET/CRV/BCH/LINK/TRUMP/ZEC, but zero names reached the confirmed depth queue. ZEC regained the 105.85% rate gate at 114.4123% APR with $351.809M OI; its 26-print/24.001-hour episode accrued 19.2738 bps, 66.46% of the 29 bps floor. FET's rate eased from 186.3176% to 149.7783% while its eight-print/6.750-hour episode reached 8.3219 bps, 28.70%. ONDO accelerated from 170.9104% to 311.7320% APR with $26.311M OI and earned 7.1412 bps across nine prints, 24.62%. ETHFI reached its second print at 253.4761% APR but has only 0.5280 bps; MORPHO's 251.4452% APR is a first print with zero integrated carry. BCH is the longest secondary episode at 12 prints/10.749 hours but only 6.7004 bps. All candidates remain integrated-carry blocked, and all seven P3 regression suites passed.
**My thinking:** ZEC's rate recovery makes it the closest mature candidate again, but one-third of known cost remains uneconomized after a full day. ONDO's point rate is exceptional yet its earned carry is below one-quarter of fees; FET and BCH show the same gap between attractive snapshots and realized economics. The wider frontier therefore increases the watch list, not executable opportunity.
**Decision:** Keep the 29 bps integrated-carry floor, 105.85% APR buffer, $5M OI floor, public hedge requirement, and continuity rules frozen. Continue ZEC, FET, ONDO, BCH, GRAM, LINK, ADA, CRV, TRUMP, and ETHFI as research watches; first-print block MORPHO and the other five new names. Do not request paired depth, promote, change configuration, or trade live.
